1 scam reported in Lake Arthur for week ending July 11, 2026
G. I. Patel
The Better Business Bureau listed one scam report for Lake Arthur for the week ending July 11, 2026.
There were no scam reports for the city in the previous week.
Reported losses totaled $1,000 in the one report that included a dollar amount.
The largest reported loss for the week was $1,000 in a sweepstakes/lottery/prizes scam; the report excerpt stated: "PcH agent james goodman -Person stated that family won prizes and asked for money in the form of gift cards to deliver prizes "
BBB Scam Tracker lets consumers search reported scams and share their experiences to help others spot similar schemes. The BBB says it reviews each report before publication and does not publicly display the reporter’s name or personal contact information.
Fraud reports nationwide have continued to show large financial losses. The Federal Trade Commission said consumers reported losing more than $12.5 billion to fraud in 2024, a 25% increase from the previous year.
